title: What Types of Training Are Provided?
content: The training provided covers a variety of topics including Agriculture, Environment, Climate, Agribusiness, Crop diseases and pests and their solutions, Soil management, Fertilizers, and Pesticides, among others.

title: Is the Training Online or Offline?
content: The training is provided offline and not online. Participants must attend the sessions in person.

title: Where Should I Contact to Receive Training?
content: To receive training, please contact 01741122755 directly for guidance and registration.

title: What is the Registration Fee for Training?
content: The registration fee depends on the training topic. For details, please contact 01741122755 directly.

title: What is the Duration of the Training?
content: The duration of the training depends on the topic. For specific information, please contact 01741122755 directly.
